Tea shop orders, one made-up week

Wednesday was the busiest day, and a counter order takes about 12 minutes from till to ready.

Orders by day

DayOrders
Monday120

That makes 1240 orders this month so far.

How an order moves

  1. The customer places an order at the till.
  2. The till sends the order to the kitchen.
  3. The kitchen marks it ready within about 12 minutes.
